messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — I ran a quick audit and ~1.2k onboarding accounts are showing as 'stale' (no activity 14+ days). Can we bulk-claim or reassign these into the nurture playbook?

ajay_ops: thanks for flagging. what's the exact definition you used for stale? we need to match playbook triggers.

maria_cs: using last_touch IS NULL OR last_touch < now() - interval '14 days' + missing onboarding milestone 'setup_complete'. quick SQL sampler below.

lucy_data: paste the SQL? want to make sure we don't pull trial->paid false positives. also need product_segment filter.

maria_cs: sure —
```sql
SELECT account_id, owner_id, last_touch, onboarding_stage FROM accounts
WHERE onboarding_stage != 'setup_complete'
AND (last_touch IS NULL OR last_touch < now() - interval '14 days')
AND product_segment IN ('core', 'starter');
LIMIT 2000;
```

sam_platform: fwiw the playbook runner can take a csv of account_ids and a target playbook id. We can queue a bulk job but need a safe rollback. ops-bot can create a dry-run first.

ops-bot: [automated] Bulk playbook assignment dry-run created by sam_platform. Job id: dryrun-2026-06-05-51. Preview shows 1203 accounts, 94 owners missing.

ajay_ops: missing owners are the risk. How do we want to handle unowned accounts? auto-claim to onboarding_pool or escalate to cs_team?

maria_cs: prefer auto-claim to onboarding_pool for now, with a follow-up nudge to owners if any. owners missing -> tag as unclaimed and route to ops queue.

lucy_data: I'll add a segment filter to exclude accounts with recent trial conversion events in the last 7 days; those shouldn't be in nurture. Also will compute a healthscore delta to avoid harming accounts trending positive.

sam_platform: proposed steps:
1) run dry-run and inspect sample (ops-bot already made it)
2) run small batch (200) with auto-claim to onboarding_pool + tag unclaimed
3) monitor 48h for regressions (emails, churn signals)
4) if green, schedule full bulk with staggered windows

maria_cs: +1. can we add an eval metric to check pre/post healthscore distribution? lucy, can you provide baseline snapshot?

lucy_data: yes. I'll export pre_bulk_health.csv with columns account_id, healthscore_v1, last_touch, owner_id and post-batch snapshot to compare. Will also include top 3 risk_signals. ETA 2h.

ajay_ops: who will run the small batch? I can kick it off if sam_platform provides the playbook id and the CLI snippet.

sam_platform: CLI snippet:
```bash
redwood playbooks run --job-prefix bulk-onboard-claim --playbook-id pb_4321 --input-file accounts_to_claim.csv --mode dry-run
redwood playbooks run --job-prefix bulk-onboard-claim --playbook-id pb_4321 --input-file accounts_to_claim.csv --mode live --claim-to onboarding_pool
```

maria_cs: I'll prepare accounts_to_claim.csv after lucy shares filters. Planning window: tomorrow 09:00 PST for the small batch.

ops-bot: [automated] Scheduled job small-batch-1765440001 at 2026-06-06T09:00:00-08:00 by maria_cs.

lucy_data: FYI adding a safety: skip accounts with last_support_ticket < 7d and any active_premium_flag = true. want to avoid touching enterprise.

ajay_ops: sounds good. one more ask — add an alert in Console to watch for spike in reassignments per owner, threshold 50/hr. if hit, auto-pause bulk.

sam_platform: will add guardrails: concurrency limit + auto-pause webhook to #eng-oncall and this channel.

maria_cs: thanks all. i'll post the final csv and kickoff notes once lucy uploads the snapshots. post small-batch results here. :crossed_fingers:

ops-bot: [automated] small-batch-1765440001 completed (dry-run: OK). Preview sample 200 accounts. No immediate red flags.

ajay_ops: great — let's go live at the scheduled time unless lucy finds issues.

lucy_data: uploaded pre_bulk_health.csv and filter manifest to S3: s3://redwood-cs-bulk/onboard-stale/2026-06-05/. Link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-cs-bulk/onboard-stale/2026-06-05/pre_bulk_health.csv

maria_cs: received. thanks lucy. proceeding with small-batch tomorrow.
